entities.title: Daemon socket handshake
entities.summary: A client opens <state dir>/daemon.sock, sends one JSON line naming its version and roots, reads one JSON reply line, and then speaks MCP over the same connection.
consumers: zazzle-csharp-indexer serve (Proxy.Connect), from the same or another build of the binary
zazzled (macos/rust/zazzled/), which connects to call the view tool when zazzle reads a .cs file
entities.definition: Hello: {"version": ToolVersion.Text, "roots": ["name=/abs/path" | "/abs/path", ...]}. Reply: {"ok": true}, or {"ok": false, "error": text} when a root is rejected, or {"ok": false, "restart": bool, "error": "daemon version differs"} when the versions differ. After ok, newline-delimited JSON-RPC as in src/Mcp/.dev/contracts.json until the client closes.
guarantees: The socket file is readable and writable by its owner only (not set on Windows).
A daemon whose version differs from the client's replies restart: true and stops when that client is its only one; with other clients connected it replies restart: false and keeps running.
A client told to restart waits 500 ms and tries again, at most three attempts in all, starting a new daemon when nothing answers.
A second daemon refuses to start while one answers on the socket; a stale socket file with nothing behind it is deleted.
entities.compatibility: The version check is an exact string match on ToolVersion.Text, which every release takes from its tag (macos/dotnet/zazzle-csharp-indexer/.dev/decisions.json, tool-version-source), so a released change to the handshake or to MCP behaviour reaches clients once the old daemon is idle. Builds outside a release all say 0.0.0-dev and are not told apart.
